name: manor-savanna
description: Noble's Manor, the savanna look (ROADMAP 49.10f): the shipped Manor drawn again as a chief's great house: one broad golden thatch hip over the wing and the hall (a T over the ballroom at III), a colonnade of grey acacia posts under its eaves, red granite below and packed mud above with a painted band, thatched verandas in the front bays, the tower through the thatch under its own steep pyramid, a walled yard round the family's acacia (II), a ribbed cellar (IV).
